title: [3.0-beta1] Objectives have wrong status text
body:
On old version (2.8.x): 
- Done items are green, and text is "Completed, well done!"
- Not done items are orange and text is "Not completed yet"

On new version (3.0):
- Done items are green, and text is "Not completed yet"  WRONG!!! 
- Not done items are orange and text is "Not completed yet"
- after you have completed all the items then text changes to "Completed, well done!"
